oracle.statement: G same body on existing collection -> 200 non-empty (else SCRIPT_ERROR); N1 missing collection -> 404 EXACTLY (2xx = Type1_IllegalSuccess: answered against a nonexistent collection; 400/422 = Type4 mapping violation); N2 missing collection + limit=0 -> any 4xx (200 = Type1); N3 lookup_from to missing collection -> 4xx (200 = Type1 candidate); 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3
